title: Offline Apprenticeship Learning for Human-Centric Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.28716v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective decision-making in human-centric environments such as Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs) and clinical healthcare requires policies that are adaptive, data-efficient, and ethically deployable. Apprenticeship Learning (AL) infers policies directly from expert demonstrations by recovering the underlying reward structure, enabling strictly offline learning without environment interaction. This dissertation develops a progression of offline AL frameworks organized around two challenges: reward modeling and demonstration quality. For reward modeling, EM-EDM clusters demonstrations by latent reward functions and induces cluster-specific policies, and THEMES partitions trajectories into temporally coherent sub-trajectories guided by a hierarchically learned reward regulator; across one educational and three clinical datasets, THEMES outperforms flat and hierarchical AL baselines. translated_title: 以人为本环境中的离线学徒学习
translated_abstract: 在智能辅导系统（ITSs）和临床医疗等以人为本的环境中，有效的决策需要具备自适应性、数据高效性和伦理可部署性的策略。学徒学习（AL）通过恢复潜在的奖励结构，直接从专家演示中推断策略，从而实现无需环境交互的严格离线学习。本论文围绕两大挑战——奖励建模与演示质量——构建了一系列递进的离线学徒学习框架。在奖励建模方面，EM-EDM 通过潜在奖励函数对演示进行聚类并归纳出特定于各聚类的策略，而 THEMES 在分层学习的奖励调节器引导下将轨迹划分为时间上连贯的子轨迹；在一个教育数据集和三个临床数据集上，THEMES 的表现优于扁平型和分层型的学徒学习基线。在演示质量方面，HALIDE 整合了连续的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本论文提出一系列离线学徒学习框架（包括 EM-EDM、THEMES、HALIDE），通过解决奖励建模与演示质量两大挑战，在不与环境交互的情况下从专家演示中学习适用于智能辅导系统和临床医疗等以人为本环境的自适应策略。
en_tdlr: This dissertation develops a progression of offline apprenticeship learning frameworks (EM-EDM, THEMES, HALIDE) that tackle reward modeling and demonstration quality, enabling strictly offline policy learning from expert demonstrations for human-centric domains such as intelligent tutoring systems and clinical healthcare.
